blocks.text:
Page layout and publishing
for the web and the desktop
What it is
A page-layout application for magazines, books, reports, print and websites.
It is made for people and their agents. Drop content on the Make panel, write a brief, pick a template and press Make layout, then refine the result in a full editor.
The layout core is FormDesign's own Rust engine with 394 commands and 41 tools, and the interface comes in 26 languages.
Available on macOS, Windows and Linux

blocks.k: From a brief to a layout

blocks.text: The Make pass

Intake reads your files and brief for kind, size, page count, tone, colours and brand. The Make pass ranks templates, fills them, threads the article through continuation pages, matches images to frames, fits copy and reports what is still sample text.
71 templates across magazine, newsletter, book, report, print, ad and web.
Turns Markdown, Word, RTF, text, HTML, CSV, spreadsheets, PDFs, images and a plain-words brief into one content pack. Text is composed with a Knuth-Plass paragraph composer.

Facts
Turns Markdown, Word, RTF, text, HTML, CSV, PDFs and images into one content pack.
Composes text with a Knuth-Plass paragraph composer, styles, tables and footnotes.
Exports layouts as responsive multi-page websites and publishes a link served from this computer.

deckLabel.default: FormDesign publication, swipe to turn pages

propDocs.pages: Array of pages in order, two per leaf (front, back). A page is {blocks:[...], bleed?:{src,light?,alt,w,h}}. Block types: k, mono {spans, cls?}, mast, shot, thumb, cline, hd, p, num, tip, sig, chip, lede, pull, colo, seps, signoff, link {text,href}, button {text,href,kind}, btns {buttons}, socials {links}, list {rows:[{a,b,c,go}]}, grid {figs}, quote {text,src}, copy {text,url,label,done,fail}, ruler {bars:[[height%,width px]]}, card {k,hd}. Pictures take src, optional light twin, w, h, alt.
propDocs.names: One name per spread (the cover, each opened spread, the back cover). Used for labels and the live region.
propDocs.spreadVariable: Name of a number variable. The component writes the current spread (0 is the cover) and turns to a spread when the variable is set elsewhere, so native dots can bind to it.
propDocs.savedVariable: Name of a boolean variable the component resets to false each time the spread changes.

fallback: Without script the poster shows the cover spread. With reduced motion a page change jumps straight to the new spread and every control stays usable.
